Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing a person to apply for a minor work permit without completing a new master application under certain circumstances.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the submission of new master applications bypersons seeking minor work permits; and adding a new section to chapter19.02 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.02 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A person seeking a minor work permit under RCW 49.12.121 is notrequired to complete an entirely new master application if there are nochanges to any other information submitted on the most recent masterapplication. Such a person need only complete a new master applicationto the extent necessary to provide information relevant to hiring aminor and to identify the employer seeking the permit, including theaddress and contact information for the employer.
